title: polyframes
description: Polybar window-list renderer for herbstluftwm: a bunli/Bun CLI compiled to a standalone native binary - rofi menus, typed one-shot window rules, and the WM read as typed JSON via herbstutil; the float-register imperatives come from herbctl.

content.heading: polyframes - the polybar window-list renderer, as a native binary
content: polyframes renders herbstluftwm's window state as the polybar center module: one label per (frame, window-class) group, decorated by state (focused gold underline, floating, minimized dimmed), with click/scroll actions that re-exec the binary itself. Built with Bun and bunli, compiled to a standalone executable - so it runs wherever the bar runs, no node, no nvm PATH, no shim.
[https://github.com/akinevz2/polyframes](https://github.com/akinevz2/polyframes)

content.heading: The bar daemon
content: A bare invocation is polybar's contract: print one bar line, then keep it fresh - a `herbstclient --idle` hook listener for instant focus/tag/title updates, plus a 1s layout poll that hashes `herbstclient dump` (frame splits and removals emit no hook in hlwm 0.9.5).
`polyframes bar` prints a single line and exits - the same pure renderer, scriptable.

content.heading: Grouping model
content: Clients on the focused tag arrive in WM order, enriched per window: class, title, minimized, floating, and its parent frame's flat index (`-1` when the root is unsplit).

Group keys: `minflt|wid` and `unframed|wid` are solo labels; `frame|frame|class` groups same-class windows sharing a frame. A group's representative is the frame's selected client - but only when it belongs to the group's class, so a mixed-class frame never leaks another group's title.
Render order keeps WM order, pushes minimized labels last, truncates to `char_limit` with an ellipsis, folds forbidden classes (the bar itself), and emits a `+N` overflow marker past `max_windows`.

content.heading: The keybind registers live in doftiles
content: The float-register state machines (mod-f / mod-x / mod-ctrl-f: float-focus, float-yank, zoom) live in herbctl - the keybinds spawn those herbctl verbs; they are documented in the [herbctl project](/projects/herbctl). The polyframes side of the same bindings is the frame surgery: tile/center/resize/fit re-executed in the bar's click actions.

content.heading: The helper suite, migrated in
content: The dotfiles' herbst helpers moved in as subcommands, so one binary manages them all:
`tags`, `hidden`, `windows`, `launch` - the rofi menus (script-mode protocol, NUL-separated rows, per-row icons and states)
`switcher-menu`, `window-menu` - detached menu targets the click actions spawn
`tile` - closest-empty-frame navigation or split (the frame-tree surgery)
`center` - decoration-aware centering (`--wid` targets a specific window's own frame)
`resize` - delta nudges, frame/root deco-flush fills, explicit content rects
`fit` - constraint pass: shrink oversized, nudge off-screen (monitor or frame target)
`spawn` - one-shot `herbstclient rule once` spawns with typed flags (`--class/--float/--center/--tag`)

content.heading: herbstutil + herbctl inside
content: Two sibling libraries ride along at build time:
herbstutil (npm) - parseAttr for every WM read: typed JSON out of hlwm's attr output, one round trip instead of a per-client attribute walk.
herbctl - the imperatives the scroll/click actions run: float+center, minimize-keep-frame, empty-frame removal - the keybind state machines as importable functions.
Both resolve as sibling submodules in the doftiles depends/ layout and from the npm/GitHub registries everywhere else.
